ValidationRule.description: Salutation and FirstName fields should be required for personAccount
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(CONTAINS($User.Username, 'loads.user') = false,CONTAINS($User.Username, 'apiuser') = false, NOT( $Permission.BypassValidationRulesCP ), Potential__c = false, IsPersonAccount, OR( ISPICKVAL(Salutation, ''), ISBLANK(FirstName) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Salutation and FirstName fields should be required for Person Account.
